line: my friend dragged me here. no offense but i think this stuff is cold reading. you're going to tell me i'm stressed about something. everyone is.
see, that's exactly what a cold reader would say. ask me something a computer couldn't guess.
...fine. one real thing. i applied to grad school without telling my wife. results come friday.
because if i don't get in, it never happened. and if i do get in, we have to have the conversation.
